TS18047: `heading` may be `null`
  at possibly-null.ts:4:10

    3 |   const heading = document.querySelector("h1");
  > 4 |   return heading.textContent ?? "";
                 ^^^^^^^
    5 | }

  `heading` can be `null` here — `querySelector` returns `null` when nothing matches. TypeScript won't let you read from it until the code rules that out.

  Fix: Narrow it first:
    if (heading === null) {
      throw new Error("heading is missing"); // or return a fallback
    }
    return heading.textContent ?? "";
  Or, when a missing value may flow on as `undefined`:
  return heading?.textContent ?? "";

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS18047 [ERROR]: 'heading' is possibly 'null'.
  │   return heading.textContent ?? "";
  │          ~~~~~~~
  │     at file:///app/possibly-null.ts:4:10

error: Type checking failed.
